reasoning_content: Now install php8.2 with required extensions.

action.command:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get install -y -qq php8.2-cli php8.2-sqlite3 php8.2-mbstring php8.2-xml php8.2-curl php8.2-gd php8.2-zip php8.2-bcmath php8.2-intl php8.2-fileinfo unzip 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "EXIT:$?"
php -v
echo "---modules---"
php -m | grep -i -E "sqlite3|mbstring|xml|curl|fileinfo|gd|zip|bcmath|intl"
